findings.text: follow-on: _drop_doc_reference now finds the bare reference through doc_links.find_name_references, whose _INLINE_NAME_RE carries the lookbehind (?<![A-Za-z0-9_]) (imas_codex/standard_names/doc_links.py:21), while the local regex it replaced carried (?<![\w:/]) (harmonize.py:996 at the base revision f4fd209a9); the delegation therefore drops a name:<target> preceded by '/' or ':', so a target appearing inside a URL path such as https://host/name:foo is now stripped where the old pattern preserved it. Narrow and unlikely in prose, but it is a behaviour change from the delegation that the reverse-link tests do not cover, so it should be named rather than left implicit in the swap.

follow-on: the node's done_when requires the reverse-link step to call resolve_doc_links and find_name_links in place of its local rewrite, but the landed change calls only find_name_links and find_name_references (harmonize.py:995,1002) and never resolve_doc_links; the brief permits this shape (it directs the worker to name a signature gap in the fragment when an owner does not fit), and the worker documents the gap at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-harmonize-command/shc-reverse-links.html, because resolve_doc_links(gc=None) (imas_codex/standard_names/graph_ops.py:9684) is a graph-wide pass over every accepted StandardName that decides deadness from REFINED_FROM and writes back, whereas _drop_doc_reference is a pure in-process rewrite of one prose string for one target inside a batch still being composed. The deviation is sound and disclosed, but the requirement in the done_when is not literally met.

follow-on: assert drain.calls[1][1] == pytest.approx(5.0 - anchor_charge) restates the claim already made at :451, and 5.0 and anchor_charge are both values the test itself supplied (the CampaignBudget ceiling and the cost_fn hook), so the line adds no figure independent of the test's own inputs; it does not redden on any code change the :451 assertion would not already catch.
